scientific_question: Can trainable entity binding and learned causal relational memory compose counterfactual effects across unfamiliar causal structures better than equally informed and fully trained recurrent, relational and symbolic controls without resource regression or hard false positives?

public_information_feasibility.required_first: Show which distinctions among candidate causal mechanisms are identifiable from the *actual public observations and public interventions* before training learned memories or consuming new source-born tasks
public_information_feasibility.observational_equivalence_witness: Binary U; models A X:=U,Y:=X,Z:=Y and B X:=U,Y:=U,Z:=Y. For all observational U histories the three public variables coincide, but do(X:=1-U) changes Y,Z only in A. Even arbitrarily many purely observational samples cannot decide between these models. A public intervention on X with U-observed baseline can distinguish the two witness models, not all possible models.
public_information_feasibility.analyze: Enumerate all 2^8 observational latent histories; verify output and entity-role traces identical for both witness SCMs; verify intervention responses differ, including two-edge counterfactual composition X->Y->Z
public_information_feasibility.assumptions: No unobserved confounder absence, intervention completeness, counterfactual identifiability or causal structure is assumed by default. If the source lacks a public discriminating intervention, natural abstention is mandatory for underdetermined counterfactual claims.

planned_mechanism.representation: Bounded recurrent relational slots that learn identity bindings, adjacency/causal influence and message routing from public transition histories, updated online without advance access to future queries
planned_mechanism.allowed_prior: Generic graph equivariance to entity renaming and differentiable memory routing; no explicit operator family lookup, hidden causal adjacency, symbolic expression templates or privileged source identifiers
planned_mechanism.learned_composition: State transition must reuse learned entity relationships over multiple directed hops and counterfactual interventions; learned binding and update each individually ablative
planned_mechanism.model_capacity: Freeze exact parameter count, memory bytes, recurrent unroll length and optimizer steps before introducing new source-born cases; no budget expansion after a negative

trained_controls: Independent fully trained recurrent sequence comparator with same public inputs, labels, optimizer steps and memory ceiling
Independent fully trained relational or graph-memory comparator with same public inputs, labels and capacity ceiling
Strong source-neutral symbolic SCM/version-space intervention-consistency reasoner with abstention when counterfactual not identifiable
Best currently qualified prior baseline on compatible subsets; report out-of-class abstentions transparently

data_contract.sourcefree_pilot: No hidden law families, reserved F124-DK sources or protected cases used in analytic first feasibility
data_contract.source_identity_custody: Externally or independently authored prospective source family, cryptographic birth/ref and separate first-use witnessed by existing CKB-plane research authority
data_contract.independent_novelty: Previously untrained causal operators, variable roles, unseen relation and entity permutations, length/composition increases and counterfactual interventions
data_contract.equal_information: Every learned arm sees exact same public FIT histories and any permitted public interventions; no extra oracle labels, privileged task IDs or future-query leakage

evaluation.paired_unseen_exact_causal_sequence_succ: Required genuine improvement over *strongest* fully trained equally informed comparison; preserve per-family denominator and natural abstentions
evaluation.counterfactual_integrity: Require correct predicted outcomes for intervened target, downstream entities and unchanged negative controls; no truth-labeled CHECK/HELDOUT training
evaluation.training_and_inference_resource_custody: Measure separate and full child OS user+sys CPU/RSS, native operation/FLOP or declared matched-work proxies, at least 3 independent complete process repeats per arm/source, no unfair CPU comparison from weak code
ablation: erase learned identity binding slots under same compute/memory
shuffle learned relational/causal adjacency assignments without truth leakage
disable learned counterfactual propagation at matched operations
evaluation.independent_reproduction: A second disjoint source family generated independently after model and comparator freeze; do not tune on first original outcome
evaluation.scientific_acceptance: Only independent existing scientific authority after complete matched cost and original provenance

execution.next_gate_conditional: Only after analytic feasibility proof and complete source-only evidence, implement frozen candidate and independently trained controls; original first-use remains blocked pending eligible independent custody.
